architectureDecisions: D1 Emit a binary patch for review plus an incremental v2 bundle to retain exact SHA-1 commit objects; patch replay alone preserves tree, not commit. SHA-only is not portable. Use full ancestor base history; no external repository/framework adoption.

D2 Create a private named ref only in a temporary bare exporter whose alternates read source objects. Bundle that ref excluding base. Never update source refs/config; published objects must survive exporter/source deletion.

D3 Normalize BB-127 protected historical PASS into the explicit dependencyAdapter.packet projection; verify original result/files first. Export a separately hashed portable replay config and sanitized summary, preserving original goal/contract/runtime/config/result/summary/stream hashes as historical opaque pins. Never relabel original acceptance as executed under portable config or copy absolute host paths.

D4 Opt in with reviewOutputDir/--review-out. Write private sibling staging under external output root, validate and sync all bytes, rename to manifest digest, sync parent, then clean QA/recovery. Use exclusive publisher lock and fail rather than overwrite corrupt existing output.

D5 Reviewer supplies clean complete base and independent manifest/evaluator/config pins. Follow S3 safe import/checkout and explicit evaluator replay. Fresh PASS binds actual supplied Node24 identity and candidate; original acceptance remains historical. dependencyAdapter.portableConfig defines exact conversion and root-last argv.

D6 Stream binary outputs with quotas/timeouts and argument arrays/shell:false. Export retained bounded acceptance summary with complete:false and independent original stdout/stderr digests from protected verification; do not invent unavailable raw log bytes. Fresh explicit replay captures its own bounded logs plus full-stream digests and generates a new result. Transport objects, patch and evaluator bytes are never silently truncated.

D7 Refactor the private fresh-QA helper with an optional before-dispose export callback, shared by fresh and ACCEPTED-handle routes. Requested export runs inside checkout try after protected PASS; helper finally disposes QA even on error. Only successful export permits recovery disposal; requested failure returns REVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED and retains recovery. Without request preserve old status/result/cleanup behavior.

D8 Same commit as base uses BASE_ONLY/empty patch/no bundle; same tree with different commit still bundles. Reject nonancestor/shallow/missing base, gitlinks/LFS pointers, non-UTF8 filenames, unsafe output and unsupported object format. Parse UTF-8 path records with NUL delimiters.

D9 Artifact export is local review handoff, no SCM/value/release authority. Hashes provide integrity against operator pins, not signatures. Exact objects can include committed sensitive bytes; no redaction while claiming unchanged identity. Evaluators are trusted local processes.

Artifact entries {path,role,bytes,sha256,complete,originalStreamSha256?}; no self-hash or exporter host metadata (timestamps, absolute host paths, prompt/env/handle/transcript). Exact Git transport/patch preserves all committed bytes; this metadata restriction is not a claim that source blobs are redacted. Fixed regular filenames only: manifest.json,candidate.patch,candidate.bundle (incremental only),evaluator.mjs,evaluator-config.json,acceptance-result.json,acceptance-summary.log,qa-records.json,qa-summary.log. qa-records.json normalizes name/claim/status/candidate/evidence hash/reason/exit/stream digests plus sourceRecordSha256; qa-summary.log is sanitized bounded text with separate sourceSummarySha256. Do not copy root-dependent raw QA envelopes. List/hash every artifact except manifest exactly once; reject extra/missing/duplicate/unknown/traversal/symlink entries. Git steps: ["Resolve commits/trees; SHA-1 format, ancestor check, full nonshallow base required. Detect unsupported tree modes/LFS pointers and unsafe candidate symlinks: inspect mode120000 blob bytes without following links; require a relative UTF-8 target that resolves within the candidate tree and never into .git; reject absolute/escaping targets. Temporary bare exporter uses source rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path objects, private alternates and update-ref refs/heads/review-candidate candidateSha.", "bundle create --version=2 <stage>/candidate.bundle refs/heads/review-candidate ^<baseSha>. Require exactly candidate/ref from list-heads; parse prerequisite IDs, require each prerequisite ancestor of base and complete in base-only verifier. Record actual frontier, never infer only one from baseSha.", "diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-renames baseSha candidateSha -- streamed to patch. diff --name-status -z --no-renames parsed status/path records.", "Before publication verify/import bundle in independent temporary base-only repo with complete base objects and no source/export alternates, fsck and compare commit/tree. BASE_ONLY skips bundle and requires empty patch; different commit/equal tree still bundles."] Publication: Validate nonempty outputRoot before agent spawn; realpath existing parents, require private POSIX local output outside source worktree/Git common dir/recovery/Backend/QA scratch, reject containment in either direction and symlink components. Exclusive .review-export.lock serializes publishers; existing lock means OUTPUT_BUSY/manual stale-lock recovery. Own random .stage-* mode0700/files0600 with exclusive creation. Await write+file sync+stage sync and byte verification; under lock rename to digest directory without overwrite, sync parent before returning EXPORTED. Existing exact output must fully revalidate to reuse; corrupt collision fails unchanged. Post-rename sync failure returns failure while retaining complete final artifact. Remove only own lock/staging/exporter. Limits: {"bundleBytes": 134217728, "patchBytes": 33554432, "manifestBytes": 1048576, "evidenceAggregateBytes": 4194304, "totalBytes": 173015040, "gitTimeoutMs": 120000, "policy": "Positive integer overrides may lower caps only; no CLI tuning in this task. Stream bytes/hash/count, shell:false; kill process group and await close on overflow/timeout, clean partial stages. Never advertise incomplete external acceptance logs as complete."}

S2 — deliver-slice.js; ATOMIC_LIFECYCLE. Add optional private onAcceptedBeforeDispose callback to runQaOnFreshCheckout, preserving existing callers. Invoke it inside that helper try after ordinary plus BB-127 protected QA PASS, while its exact candidate checkout still exists, before finally disposes workspace. Both fresh finishBackend and ACCEPTED-handle paths pass the same export callback. The callback builds normalized pinned packet and awaits exportReviewBundle; attach returned bundle metadata to QA result. finishBackend disposes matching recovery only after successful requested export; export error maps REVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED/reason/backendSha/sanitizedQA/reviewBundle:null, retains recovery, and helper finally still removes QA. Failed QA exports nothing; no request preserves old lifecycle. Validate reviewOutputDir and self-contained evaluator profile before Backend. Packet schema is deliveryContract.reviewBundle.dependencyAdapter.packet: memory-only original BB-127 bytes and trusted pin/record are validated first, then historical projection/evaluator/portableConfig/sanitized summary are exported with separate source/full-stream hashes. Rehash retained bytes and subject pins. No full-stream capture API or local-command-verifier source edit is assumed. Portable config conversion is the explicit dependencyAdapter.portableConfig rule; raw BB-127 manifest/config is never relabelled as identical portable bytes.

S3 — review-bundle.js and bin/exharness-agent.mjs; FRESH_REPLAY/COMPATIBILITY. replayReviewBundle({bundleDirectory,repositoryRoot,expectedManifestSha256,expectedEvaluatorSha256,expectedConfigSha256,executeEvaluator=false}). Six fixed steps: (1) require clean complete exact base, SHA1 and caller pins; validate strict manifest/file set/caps and byte hashes before effects; (2) verify bundle/list-heads/prerequisite frontier or exact BASE_ONLY/no bundle/empty patch; (3) fetch declared ref --no-tags to refs/heads/review/<manifestSha256>, refusing different existing target; (4) detach exact candidate without force/reset using sanitized Git environment (GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, no inherited GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*/GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY/GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES). Before import reject local configured filter.* drivers and core.sparseCheckout; use private empty core.hooksPath and core.autocrlf=false/core.eol=lf. A candidate .gitattributes filter name has no driver and cannot execute. Hash checkout regular bytes against blobs and symlink targets against mode120000 blobs; assert HEAD/tree/NUL changed paths; (5) explicit true rehashes and executes trusted standalone evaluator with process.execPath with argv [evaluator,...config.args,candidateRoot] (root last), after checking supplied Node major24, shell:false/timeout/bounded logs; false returns NOT_EVALUATED after import; (6) true requires exit0/unchanged HEAD-tree-status, emits fresh subject-bound PASS or REPLAY_FAILED plus stream digests. Historic PASS never transfers. CLI deliver --review-out forwards reviewOutputDir; review --bundle --repository --manifest-sha256 --evaluator-sha256 --config-sha256 requires all pins and explicit true. Exit0 PASS,64 malformed,1 failure. Existing routing compatible.

dependencyAdapter.producer: BB-127 external acceptance; its DRAFT has no delivered return API. deliver-slice.js maps actual upstream return shape, never invents an existing symbol. Contradiction requires research/rejudgment before Worker.
dependencyAdapter.packet: In-memory input {source:{manifestBytes,resultBytes,evaluatorBytes,summaryBytes,protectedPin,verifierRecord},sliceId,baseSha,candidateSha,candidateTree}. protectedPin is trusted BB-127 pin from this fresh QA gate, not an agent assertion. validateReviewEvidence first hashes raw manifest/evaluator/result/summary, checks pin/record PASS/current candidate+tree and complete revision/reason/exit/stream hashes; returns immutable export projection. Derive portableConfig bytes from verified args/timeout, with its own hash. Project acceptance-result.json {status:HISTORICAL_PASS,candidateSha,candidateTree,evaluatorSha256,portableConfigSha256,sourceResultSha256,sourceProtectedManifestSha256,originalGoalDigest,originalContractDigest,originalRuntimeSha256,originalStdoutSha256,originalStderrSha256}. Raw root-dependent manifest/result bytes remain memory-only and are not exported. Sanitize bounded summary, hash exported bytes separately, retain sourceSummarySha256 and complete:false. Fresh replay independently evaluates portable config and actual supplied runtime; historic PASS does not transfer.
dependencyAdapter.profile: Self-contained pinned .mjs and separately hashed canonical portable config; conversion, authority and runtime rules are in portableConfig. Reject unsupported multi-file/external-path profiles before dispatch. Summary complete:false retains original stream hashes.
dependencyAdapter.portableConfig: The exported config is a NEW explicit replay profile, not raw BB-127 manifest bytes: sorted-key JSON {args,timeoutMs,runtimePrerequisites:["node-major:24"]}. Derive args/timeout from the already operator-pinned BB-127 manifest, reject absolute-path/credential-dependent args and non-self-contained evaluator before dispatch. Hash exported bytes separately and bind sourceProtectedManifestSha256 in result/manifest. Do not equate this hash with the original acceptance-manifest hash. Retain original goal/contract/runtime identities as historical opaque pins; never recompute original repositoryRoot-based goal digest from reviewer clone path. Fresh replay records its actual supplied Node version/binary hash and fresh environment, not an identical historical host.

reviewBundle.lifecycle: Fresh and ACCEPTED-handle finalizers export after QA/protected PASS inside QA try before finally disposal. Success adds reviewBundle {version,directory,manifestSha256,status:EXPORTED} only if requested, then disposes matching recovery. Failure returns REVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED/reason/code/backendSha/sanitized QA/reviewBundle:null; retain matching recovery. Always remove owned QA scratch; without recovery no retry retention promised. Failed QA/exhausted/unavailable exports nothing. Keep local claimBoundary.

replay.api: replayReviewBundle({bundleDirectory,repositoryRoot,expectedManifestSha256,expectedEvaluatorSha256,expectedConfigSha256,executeEvaluator:false|true}). Default validates/imports, returns NOT_EVALUATED; explicit true (review CLI) executes and returns fresh subject-bound PASS/REPLAY_FAILED with stdout/stderr digests.
sixSteps: The exact six-step algorithm is specified in S3, with root-last argv and explicit executeEvaluator=true; no alternate replay path.
replay.trust: Expected digests come from operator result/independent review, never the same untrusted manifest. Integrity is not signature/authorship. Standalone evaluator/config profile only; caller supplies declared runtime dependencies. Artifact symlinks refused; Git candidate symlinks preserved as objects and never followed during export.
replay.support: POSIX local filesystem, complete ancestor base, native SHA-1, UTF-8 names including tabs/newlines, binary files/modes/deletion/safe candidate symlinks. Reject gitlinks (ls-tree -r -z mode160000), LFS pointer blobs (standard version prefix), shallow graph/nonancestor and unsupported object format; no claim of LFS/submodule runtime replay. Safe candidate symlinks mean relative UTF-8 targets resolved inside the candidate tree and outside .git; inspect blob targets without following them. Reject escaping/absolute targets before checkout. Reject candidate .gitattributes eol/working-tree-encoding conversion declarations before checkout; no claim of byte-identical replay under those checkout transforms. System/global attributes are excluded (GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1 and private empty core.attributesFile).
replay.argumentOrder: Exact execution argv is [absoluteEvaluatorPath,...config.args,realpath(candidateCheckout)] with candidate root LAST, matching BB-127. Require supplied Node major24; no automatic install or runtime-binary transport. Runtime differs explicitly in the fresh replay receipt. Exported config/evaluator hashes remain exact caller pins.
